item.title: Weather Update: Severe cold wave sweeps North India; Rain likely in NCR
item.description: North India is witnessing intense cold wave conditions with dense fog, light rain and freezing winds affecting daily life. Several states including Delhi-NCR, UP, Punjab and Haryana are on alert for cold day conditions.

item.title: Gold prices surge sharply as global tensions fuel safe-haven demand
item.description: Gold prices recorded a strong weekly rally, with 24-carat gold rising ₹4,640 per 10 grams, while silver surged ₹19,000 per kilogram. The sharp gains are driven by heightened global uncertainty and increased demand for safe-haven assets.

item.title: Trump says US ready to help bring freedom to Iran; Khamenei issues death penalty warning
item.description: Political tensions are escalating as protests continue across Iran. US President Donald Trump has said America is ready to help Iranians gain freedom from their current leadership. Washington has warned Tehran against using force on protesters, while Iran’s supreme leadership has issued strict threats, including severe punishment for those supporting demonstrations.

item.title: US launches major airstrikes on ISIS targets in Syria; Sends strong message to terror groups
item.description: The United States has carried out a large-scale airstrike operation against ISIS in Syria under Operation Hawkeye Strike. According to CENTCOM, multiple precision attacks were conducted on terrorist hideouts across different regions.

item.title: Massive crowd gathers at Sangam as Magh Mela sees Maha Kumbh-like preparations
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 is underway at Prayagraj’s sacred Sangam, drawing millions of devotees despite cold and fog. Organized on a grand scale as a rehearsal for the upcoming Maha Kumbh, the fair features strict security, advanced facilities, and spiritual fervor.

item.title: India cracks down on obscene imagery as X deletes 600 accounts; Details here
item.description: Social media platform X admitted lapses in content moderation after concerns over obscene imagery in India. Following government intervention, about 3,500 pieces of content were blocked and over 600 accounts removed.

item.title: Platform X admits lapse in content; Deletes 600 accounts, 3500 posts
item.description: Central Government Issued Warning This action comes a week after the Union Ministry of Information Technology issued a warning against X. The central ministry accused Grok AI of "gross misuse" and of creating and sharing images or videos of women in a "derogatory or obscene" manner, thereby defaming them inappropriately.

item.title: Who is Yesha Sagar? WPL 2026’s stunning anchor steals spotlight
item.description: Yesha Sagar captured attention as a glamorous and confident anchor during WPL 2026 on January 9. Before sports anchoring, she worked as a model and appeared in popular Punjabi and Hindi music videos, including songs by Tony Kakkar.

item.title: PM Modi leads ‘Shaurya Yatra’ in Somnath; Pays tribute to bravehearts
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi led the Shaurya Yatra at Somnath, Gujarat, honoring those who sacrificed their lives to protect the temple. The procession featured 108 horses and drew thousands of devotees along the route.
